headline: Charleston shuts out Davis & Elkins
dek: Charleston scored three unanswered goals against Davis & Elkins in the final match on the conference calendar, finishing with nineteen wins in 22 matches. The defeat was the second of the season for Davis & Elkins, whose defense still allowed thirteen goals, the fewest in the conference.
